task_execution_gate.rationale: Baseline native cross-window undo actually raises NoneType.data and leaves the title Normal. The production patch adds AbstractTab.set_pinned using objreg current win_id and routes undo, explicit pin, clone and session restoration through it. Four focused actual Qt-widget/current-owner cases pass, followed by eleven focused/existing tabwidget/tabbedbrowser cases and compilation of the four production files. The executed native undo is exercised with the existing FakeWebTab fixture and stubbed tabopen/history deserialization, while owner lookup, pinned state and Qt titles are observed; unrelated web loading is not claimed. All three executed payload texts match the frozen source/tests after CRLF normalization. Source matches the published user content, allowing only one file-ending newline. All actual core hashes match the provider-format freeze, raw/published roles/content and guard messages match, and all tool return codes are zero. Editorial projection is historical pre-provider-format metadata; semantic_status, result and freeze bind final actual hashes. No peer review, Guard result, GT or reference/history answer was read.
